QRE-V1FC-06.evidence: The freeze script is said to name the records file and its hash; this recheck did not run the freeze script. Fact for the freeze: 06bbc7f commits reviews/ssctr/SSCTR_V1FC_EVENT_RECORDS.json (sha256 b2bcc23a...), whose only record (V1X-5K) is bound to the earlier extension hash e53a282d.... The pin is now 8a4ba9b3... and equals the committed file. So in the default authority of 06bbc7f the 5K is OFF (fallback) and the marathon UNSUPPORTED (p2 'pins', p6 last line). The 5K becomes an event only when a record is bound to 8a4ba9b3... (p6 with such a record: 5K planned and reviewed).

QRE-V1FC-07.evidence: p5b: M04, M09, M15, M26 (extensionOf), M30 and M35 are all killed by the new tests. Residual M26b (the module constant EXTENSION reading the bytes without extensionOf) survives the full suite: equivalent in the test environment, because the committed file equals the pin, and p6 shows altered and missing bytes fail closed on 06bbc7f. M13 and M14 stay defence in depth, as agreed.

The intended MISSED_SESSION difference (a target of another week or still ahead asks) is not exercised by these inputs, whose missed targets are of the review's own week and day; mutant N05 is killed by its test.
